reason: E3 shows KKR-CPA+ANN accurately predicts formation energy and phase stability (R2~1, MRE<5%), supporting the first two premises. However, no cited evidence supports extending this to free energies, transition temperatures, or capturing entropy effects, nor does any evidence compare computational speed to ab initio MD. E1 and E2 only validate KKR-CPA for structural properties and do not involve machine learning or free-energy predictions.
premises: KKR-CPA can generate accurate formation energy and lattice parameter data for HEAs
ANN can learn from KKR-CPA data to predict phase stability in HEAs
The combined KKR-CPA+ANN approach can predict thermodynamic properties beyond phase stability, such as free energies and transition temperatures
The approach captures effects of short-range order and configurational entropy
The approach is significantly faster than explicit ab initio molecular dynamics
